sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF is an uncensored derivative of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B published by JonathanColetti as GGUF quantizations with multi-token prediction (MTP) heads retained and verified. The model uses the Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration architecture with 64 layers, a 248,320-token vocabulary, a 262,144 token context window, vision capabilities, and 1 MTP layer for speculative ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored GGUF: Abliterated Local Build
sources.snippet: Bottom line "Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored GGUF" has an answer, and it is a concrete download: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF — F16 plus 12 quantization tiers for llama.cpp, the abliterated weights from our FP8 build, 262K context, vision, and MTP, under Apache 2.0 and research-only.
